section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: OS_ValidateAddress is now implemented in terms of a call to OS_Memory 24. This will validate that the region being checked has accessible memory in the region specified and that it is not a physically mapped region. As with OS_Memory 24, zero page is treated specially, despite not being mapped as a dynamic area.
